name: Sign Out Flow Integration Proof
summary: Registers real-path sign-out proof for cookie-backed and token-backed current sessions through AuthenticationFlowService and the typed SignOutFlowHandler.
notes: The tests exercise AuthenticationFlowService and the real typed SignOutFlowHandler. ISignInManager, IRefreshTokenManager and the authentication log store are security/infrastructure seams whose exact calls are asserted.
The token-backed proof verifies revocation of only the supplied current refresh token rather than all user sessions.

sourceReferences.note: Cookie and token current-session sign-out proof source.
Canonical session termination, current refresh-token revocation and audit behavior under proof.
